title: A three-column board where items can be deleted
prompt: Build a tiny board with three columns, To do, Doing and Done, that are filtered views of one store of five tasks (each task has a status field of todo, doing or done): todo has two, doing has two, done has one. Items can be deleted (the delete button asks for a second click). Put the columns in <main id="outlet"> and the store outside it. No script.

assert.eval: (() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-each')].map(e => e.querySelectorAll('ui-todo-item').length); return JSON.stringify(c.sort()) === JSON.stringify([1, 2, 2]); })()

assert.step: Each column filters on the status field
Click delete twice on 'Fix the signup bug'
assert.eval: (() => { const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].find(x => x.text === 'Fix the signup bug'); const d = i.shadowRoot.querySelector('.del'); d.click(); d.click(); return true; })()

assert.step: Wait for the store to update
The item is gone from the page
And gone from the store (4 items left)
